text: DEWALT is a brand of Stanley Black & Decker via its Black & Decker subsidiary; the parent company is publicly traded on the NYSE under SWK.
short: DEWALT belongs to Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK).

source.name: Wikipedia – DeWalt
source.quote: DeWalt is a registered trademark of Black & Decker, a subsidiary of Stanley Black & Decker.
